# Rule 3.6 Stay within your job or role. Retain reasonable knowledge, abilities, and skills according to your job and your characters' backstories. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• Do not use knowledge acquired through out-of-character means while you are in-character. This is commonly referred to as "metagaming". 

• Do not do other peoples' jobs; you should only play the role you signed up for. If you would like to work a different job, ask the Head of Personnel for a job change. - [color=lightgray]Exceptions may be made if no active staff exist for a department, assuming your character has sufficient knowledge.
• Standard crew should not be knowledgeable of most non-NT technology unless they've experienced it in-character. Security and command may have some leeway, as long as it is kept within reason. Character backstory may also influence this.
